analysis: Exploratory reference-corpus style distances; not authorship probabilities

methods.normalization: MorphGNT normalized word or lemma, Unicode NFC, accents retained
methods.feature_identity: Form counted only when token POS is eligible; frequencies divide by all retained tokens
methods.feature_selection: Top 30/50 by arithmetic mean of per-book training frequencies; ties by Unicode lexical order
methods.training_weighting: Equal contribution of whole books in feature selection, group centroids, and scale estimation
methods.burrows_delta: Mean absolute frequency difference divided by sample SD across training books; selected features only; zero-SD features omitted
methods.other: All retained tokens not counted as selected eligible-POS feature tokens
methods.holdout: One entire reference book excluded before feature selection, centroids and scales; reported at book level
methods.target_no_ch13: Remove all Hebrews chapter 13 before constructing target profile; training unchanged
methods.masking: Explicit whole-verse removal before profiles and chunks; masked chunks bridge removed spans
methods.chunks: Fixed non-overlapping retained-token blocks; tail discarded and quantified; reference chunks use held-out-book model
methods.margin: distance to Luke-Acts minus distance to Paul; positive means nearer Pauline reference centroid

limitations: Closed-set nearest reference labels do not identify an author or establish same authorship.
Even perfect 9/9 held-out reference-group accuracy does not validate open-set authorship attribution.
Nine reference books are not nine independent authors; only two Luke-Acts books constrain validation.
Luke-Acts is a conventional corpus label, not proof of the historical identity of its author.
Genre, audience, source use, collaboration, and textual transmission can affect function words.
Chunk counts and multiple configurations are descriptive sensitivity analyses, not independent replicates.
Philemon contributes a whole-book profile but has no complete 500- or 1000-token block.
Whole-verse masks also remove authorial framing and may be incomplete; inspect supplied mask documentation.
Reference holdout models differ from the full model; distances across folds are not a calibrated rejection threshold.
No comparison corpus is available here for Apollos, Priscilla, or the historical Barnabas.
Feature selection and scale estimates use no target or comparison-text tokens.
